footnote_text: Represents shares withheld by the Issuer in accordance with Rule 16b-3 to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting of restricted stock units previously granted to the Reporting Person. || Includes (i) 134,844 restricted stock units scheduled to vest on April 1, 2027, (ii) 41,537 restricted stock units scheduled to vest on May 1, 2027, (iii) 133,333 restricted stock units scheduled to vest in two substantially equal installments on March 26, 2027 and March 26, 2028, and (iv) 434,783 restricted stock units scheduled to vest in three substantially equal installments on March 25, 2027, March 25, 2028, and March 25, 2029, in each case subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment with the Issuer. Each restricted stock unit represents the right to receive one share of the Issuer's common stock.
